extraction_notes: Rates and TOFs printed in text were preferred over plot readings. Fig. 1A–D provided readable plotted catalyst-performance points; values marked '~' are approximate visual readings from the supplied page image. Fig. 2 contains Arrhenius/reaction-order plots on logarithmic axes with many closely spaced points and varying partial pressures; because individual gas compositions and exact points are not sufficiently unambiguous in the main text image, those plotted rates were not extracted. Table 1 kinetic parameters were not extracted because they are not NH3 rates/outlet concentrations/TOFs. Literature comparison values in text/tables were excluded.
